requirements.requirement: Occurrence $1,000,000; general and products/completed-operations aggregates $2,000,000; personal/advertising injury $1,000,000.
requirements.pilot_action: Request a written coverage comparison against every line; do not substitute an individual malpractice policy for agency CGL.

requirements.requirement: Occurrence $2,000,000; aggregate $2,000,000. Claims-made retrodate before contract inception; coverage continues two years after work ends.
requirements.pilot_action: Broker must confirm agency, employed clinicians and approved substitutes are insured for actual school-SLP services. Obtain renewal or extended-reporting solution and cost for the post-service obligation; buyer must accept claims-made wording.

requirements.requirement: Statutory workers compensation and NY disability; sample also lists employers liability.
requirements.pilot_action: Use WCB evidence schedule below. Do not assume a 1099 label establishes exemption; establish the employer and insurer arrangement before dispatch.

requirements.requirement: p5: NY-licensed, A.M. Best A-minus minimum. p9: authorized, secured-or-better; NY-licensed preferred.
requirements.pilot_action: Quote to the stronger p5 standard and obtain written buyer acceptance of the actual insurer; do not silently relax to the sample wording.
Buyer should confirm intended notice interval for nonpayment and responsible notifier. Broker should provide actual available endorsement wording, not promise an unsupported notice on a certificate.

requirements.requirement: District/Board on CGL. Samples: primary/noncontributory; CG2026/equivalent; ongoing/completed operations. Exceptions: WC, disability, professional liability.
requirements.pilot_action: Have broker map insured parties and policy forms, attach completed endorsements, and obtain district acceptance of equivalents. Do not add the district to professional liability by inference.

Include in quote scope pending written district clarification. Identify underlying policies and any excluded professional, auto, abuse or privacy exposures; follow-form is not evidence all risks are insured.

requirements.requirement: $1,000,000 combined single limit: owned, hired, borrowed, non-owned.
requirements.pilot_action: Disclose actual vehicle use and travel between schools. Ask whether hired/non-owned coverage satisfies a business with no owned vehicles. No student transportation is proposed.

requirements.requirement: p9 per-project aggregate; p8 off-premises-only parenthetical.
requirements.pilot_action: Request written governing schedule; do not omit CGL for on-site work based on the parenthetical because p5 directly requires it.

requirements.requirement: If required: NY-admitted surety; district obligee; original authority/acknowledgments.
requirements.pilot_action: Ask whether this procurement invokes the bond and, if so, its amount and terms. Do not present a bond as a confirmed mandatory cost.

requirements.requirement: Bid-time COI; insurer representative and bidder sign p10.
requirements.pilot_action: Collect the signed form and actual evidence before final bid assembly. A broker quotation alone is not a substitute for the requested certificate; clarify the expected in-force date and all forms due with bid.

requirements.requirement: Sample allocates deductibles/SIR to contractor; notarized hold-harmless form.
requirements.pilot_action: Have broker and counsel compare contractual liability, defense costs and uninsured obligations against policy wording before signature; insurance limits do not cap contractual exposure.
Ask if the final agreement adds one. Do not describe a waiver as a verified RFP mandate.

wcb_evidence_schedule.control: An ordinary ACORD liability certificate does not establish this coverage.

wcb_evidence_schedule.coverage: NY disability and Paid Family Leave
wcb_evidence_schedule.alternative: DB-155 for approved self-insurance; CE-200 only if genuinely exempt.
wcb_evidence_schedule.control: Use the carrier or its authorized NY agent to issue DB-120.1; a broker alone is not an authorized issuer. ACORD alone is insufficient.

wcb_evidence_schedule.insured_proof: Evidence matches contracting legal name and FEIN.
wcb_evidence_schedule.control: Do not upload FEIN or policy documents into the public research repository; store them in a restricted supplier record.

wcb_evidence_schedule.insured_proof: Contract-specific CE-200, if valid for actual facts.
wcb_evidence_schedule.control: The planned in-person employee model should be budgeted for coverage. Never infer exemption from small headcount, no current revenue, remote administration or out-of-state incorporation.

broker_rfq_brief.status: Copy-ready internal draft. No broker contacted; no application, quote or policy obtained.
broker_rfq_brief.subject: Insurance review and quotation request - proposed East Ramapo school SLP staffing pilot, RFP-ER-5-27
broker_rfq_brief.opening: Please review the attached official solicitation, Addendum 1 and requirement matrix, identify conflicts or unavailable terms, and prepare a written coverage proposal. Please do not bind coverage or treat this draft as a completed insurance application.
proposed_operations: One experienced New York-qualified school SLP and one cleared backup initially; proposed expansion ceiling three active clinicians only after assignments and coverage are approved.
In-person speech-language services to minors at district-assigned public and non-public schools in East Ramapo, New York; clinical decisions and delivery remain with qualified clinicians.
Initial contract would begin only after award and required approvals; actual start date, sites, caseload, student ages, weekly hours and contract value remain unverified.
No student transportation, clinic premises, teletherapy or unapproved subcontracting is proposed. Any change requires a new exposure and buyer review.
AI may assist staffing administration, reminders and draft reconciliation under human controls. No autonomous therapy, diagnosis, IEP decisions or unapproved student-data processing is proposed.
applicant_inputs_to_complete: Legal name, entity type, state registrations, principal address, FEIN and authorized signer.
Ownership, operating history, professional-services structure and prior related experience.
Existing policies, carriers, limits, retroactive dates, loss runs, claims or known circumstances; all currently unknown, not assumed clean.
Actual payroll by job classification, states, projected paid hours, employees versus approved contractors, and employer-of-record arrangement.
Actual projected revenue and contract value. Any unit-economics figures from the pilot workbook are illustrative planning scenarios until confirmed; label them accordingly.
Named clinician credentials and scope, hiring/reference/fingerprint process, supervision and substitute approval controls.
Vehicle ownership, hired/non-owned use, travel frequency and explicit absence or presence of pupil transport.
Data categories, retention, access control, district-approved systems, vendor contracts and incident-response arrangements.
broker_rfq_brief.quote_scope: Map each EIR requirement to proposed policy, limit, deductible/SIR, form, exclusions, named/additional insureds and evidence. Quote the broader sample schedule pending buyer confirmation; separately price optional abuse/privacy enhancements and any bond only if buyer invokes it.
requested_return: Coverage matrix with compliant / clarification needed / unavailable for each requirement; no blanket compliance assertion.
Carrier legal name, NY authorization and current financial rating; policy term and earliest realistic binding/evidence date.
Annual premium, taxes/fees, deposit, installments/finance charges, audit basis/minimum earned premium and cancellation terms separately by coverage.
Claims-made continuity or ERP cost and conditions; aggregate sharing and defense inside/outside limits.
Copies/specimens of required additional-insured, primary/noncontributory, aggregate and notice endorsements; identify waiver-of-subrogation only if required by later written terms.
Ability to complete RFP p10 representative certification and issue correct liability COI plus WCB-specific forms before the submission deadline; list what must be bound first.
Open items requiring buyer, lawyer, accountant or operator answers before binding.

insurance_budget.status: No premium quote or policy evidence obtained; dollar amounts remain unpriced.
insurance_budget.basis: Do not substitute internet averages or an individual SLP premium for agency pricing at the RFP limits. Any model allowance must be labeled an assumption and replaced by a written carrier quote.
cost_components: Excess and auto pending sample clarification
insurance_budget.allocation_rule: Use policy cash payments on their actual due dates in cash runway. For economic allocation, distinguish fixed annual insurance from payroll-audited variable premiums; do not add the same WC burden again if already included in loaded payroll.
insurance_budget.bid_control: Do not approve a final bid rate while material required insurance remains unquoted.

buyer_clarification_questions.question: Which insurance schedule governs RFP-ER-5-27: page 5, the sample on pages 7-8, or page 9? Please confirm excess, auto, per-project aggregate and whether the off-premises-only CGL parenthetical applies.

Please specify all insurance documents required with the proposal, policy effective dates, and whether additional-insured endorsements and WCB forms must accompany the bid-time COI and completed page-10 certification.

Please confirm insurer eligibility/rating, accepted additional-insured forms and scope, cancellation/nonrenewal/nonpayment notice intervals, and who must give notice. Is any waiver of subrogation required?

For claims-made professional liability, is continued coverage or an extended-reporting arrangement acceptable for the two-year post-work obligation, and what date starts that period if annual renewals occur?
For an agency with no owned vehicles and no pupil transport, what hired/non-owned auto evidence is acceptable? Is a performance bond required here, and at what amount?

operating_controls.rule: Human insurance reviewer approves issued documents and endorsements against the final buyer schedule; an AI extracted limit does not approve coverage.
operating_controls.acceptance: Missing or unresolved required proof prevents bid-ready status.

operating_controls.rule: Assignment release checks entity, clinician, service, site, policy term and approved limits.
operating_controls.acceptance: Expired policy, unapproved service or unmatched named entity blocks dispatch.

operating_controls.rule: Record policy renewal, notice deadlines, retrodates and two-year post-work obligation with evidence and accountable owner.
operating_controls.acceptance: Cancellation or nonrenewal creates an urgent human action; the system never invents continuity or backdates evidence.

operating_controls.rule: Restricted document store holds insurance evidence; public research stores only source rules and readiness status.
operating_controls.acceptance: No FEIN, loss runs, policyholder private data or issued policy files are pushed to the research repository.

operating_controls.rule: The reviewed final contract and buyer written clarifications version the insurance checklist.
operating_controls.acceptance: AI cannot silently resolve conflicting sample terms or mark the stronger requirement optional.

evidence_limits: This is a research and quotation-preparation pack, not a coverage opinion, binder, quote, exemption determination or executed contract.
No applicant-specific entity, claims, payroll, premiums or existing insurance has been verified.
Addendum 1 is the latest on the public index at inspection; recheck the procurement system and official page before submission.
No separate cyber, abuse/molestation or waiver-of-subrogation mandate was identified in the inspected RFP insurance provisions; final agreements may change requirements.
Sample provisions are unresolved applicability issues. They are included for pricing and clarification, not declared optional merely because their heading says sample.
